name: NG exhaustion chain Phase-2 P-O-X same-current post-exit re-expression characterization

scope.population_condition: parent return from structural endpoint+5 entry is negative at structural endpoint+60 exit
scope.recovery_definition: nonnegative return from original endpoint+5 entry at either structural endpoint+120 or endpoint+300 checkpoint

definition.early_relapse: nonnegative at +120 but negative again at +300

exit_path_geometry.definition: All fields are already observable when the normal parent +60 exit occurs. Shallow30 means parent return at +30 is >= -1 tick; deep30 means <= -2 ticks. Shallow60 means the adverse +60 exit is exactly -1 tick; deep60 means <= -2 ticks.

exploratory_exit_models.fit_boundary: fit on Eras 1-3 only; evaluate on Eras 4-5, untouched confirmation, then held
exploratory_exit_models.interpretation: Exit-known geometry contains information about subsequent re-expression probability, but sample sizes are small and this model is not a trade rule or promotion candidate.

interpretation.primary: The adverse same-current branch is not homogeneous after the normal exit. A shallow adverse path is much more likely to re-express to a nonnegative checkpoint within the next +120/+300 window than a path that is already deep at +30 and remains deep at +60.
interpretation.watch_role: Use this as delayed-reexpression watch priority after the parent is flat, not as automatic re-entry.
interpretation.why_not_trade: Recovery can be transient: eight of the 20 preheld shallow-shallow recoveries were nonnegative at +120 but negative again at +300. The shallow-shallow group also does not have robust positive mean +120/+300 return across preheld eras.
interpretation.deep_exception_policy: The deep-deep group still contains one preheld late recovery, so it is a low-recovery subtype, not an invalid/deleted instance class.
